ref: ADR-0008 "JSON Schema and WSDL" (maxItems 0 gives 0..0, and the field stays an array property) and "JSON as a source at run time" (the input is not validated: [1] gives one occurrence even under maxItems 0); #118
note: PO message mappings have no JSON source, so the reading is decided. $/none is an array with maxItems 0, an array property at 0..0. The input is never validated, so its one item a is one occurrence of none and All is a. Read by its maximum, none would be a leaf, the array would read as absent and no All would be written.
